name: example-libraries
description: A worked example corpus shipped with knowledge-as-code, holding the invented estate of a fictional public-library consortium. It is here to show what a corpus holds, and it governs nobody.

components.note: Reaches the published source of a record the export summarises. It names no type, so it supports the lookup skills and travels only where at least one of them did.
Reads a term from corpus/glossary/terms.jsonl and the owning glossary record beside it.
Files an observation about the corpus as an issue on the repository that published it, reading corpus/manifest.json for the address. It names no type, so it travels with every bundle.

Sends a question with no known place to the lookup skill for its type, or to the reference file beside it for a type no lookup reads. kac bundle writes its description from the trigger line of each reference file that travelled. It needs no type of its own, so it travels only where something it routes to did.

A SessionStart hook printing the breadcrumb rendered beside it, so a session learns the corpus is here before it has a question. A PreToolUse hook printing the build index at the first tool call of the main session and of each subagent, and again after a compaction, where views/build-index.md survived. They name no type, so they travel wherever a component reading one did.
